latestVersion.changelog:
Create Video with AI — Initial Release

- Generate AI-edited videos from your images or video clips; supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 500MB.
- Automated session setup with backend API, including free anonymous token flow and cloud rendering on GPUs.
- Accepts text prompts for easy video creation—add music, overlays, or edits without manual timelines.
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 files in 1-2 minutes; simple download links delivered after processing.
- Workflow covers uploading assets, editing instructions, checking credit balance, and exporting videos.
- Friendly error handling guides you if files are unsupported, too large, or plan/credit requirements aren't met.
